text:
(5) An application under this section must be served on the person against whom the order
imposing the access prohibition was made.

(6) In this section “the court” means—
(a) in a case where the prohibition order or the premises order imposing the access
prohibition was made by a court in England and Wales or Northern Ireland,
the court that made the order, except where paragraph (b) or (c) applies;
(b) where the court that made the order was the Court of Appeal, the Crown Court;
(c) where the court that made the order was a youth court but the person against
whom the order was made is aged 18 or over at the time of the application, a
magistrates' court or, in Northern Ireland, a court of summary jurisdiction;
(d) in a case where the prohibition order or the premises order imposing the access
prohibition was made by a court in Scotland, the sheriff.
